title: Ozi Work Queue Orchestration — Priority-ordered autonomous work dispatch
one_liner: Ozi maintains a work queue with priority ordering (teachings → inbound → signals → local), tracks readiness (ready vs needs_refinement), and auto-chains through jobs with minimal context + user UAT recording.
summary: Current: User asks Ozi 'what should I work on?' and Ozi discovers work ad-hoc. Better: Lug creation automatically enrolls items in a prioritized work queue. Ozi knows the burndown list, can work through it autonomously (with approval), and tracks progress in track file + UAT log. Two modes: (1) Interactive 'Work the queue' / 'Review refinements', (2) Auto-chain with approval. Each job: minimal wai context + named lug + previous track context only.
motivation: Users want to BUILD the queue, not babysit it. Ozi should discover work, prioritize, execute when approved, and auto-close. This enables: continuous delivery of framework improvements, clear burndown visibility, autonomous multi-session work chains, minimal context overhead.
user_story: Mario says: 'I'll build the queue of lugs. Ozi works through it. I get UAT + implementation notes in track. Approve auto mode and it chains: implement → closeout → load next item, minimal context, repeat until queue empty or I stop it.'
acceptance_criteria: Lug creation: auto-add to work queue with state 'ready' or 'needs_refinement'
Work queue schema: priority order, status (ready/needs_refinement), estimated steps, blocker list
Wakeup Step 9 (new): Display work queue status — ready items + pending refinements + chain option
Interactive mode: 'Work the job queue' (next ready item) OR 'Review refinements' (next needs_refinement)
Auto mode: With approval, chain jobs — implement → closeout w/ track capture → load next
Auto execution: Load only WAI core + named lug + prev track (minimal context, ~15-20k tokens)
Track capture: Every turn recorded with focus/action/thinking/implementation notes + UAT
Queue state: Persisted in WAI-State.json `_work_queue` — survives sessions
Closeout Step 10 (new): Mark completed items as done, next item auto-loaded if auto-mode enabled
